eps.d: Fred learns magic to prepare for the school's talent show.

eps.t: Frankenstone / Yard Wars / Freezy Does It
eps.d: Rocky wrecks Wilma's sister's doll, and it's up to Fred to fix it.
When Dino has to babysit Wilma's pet Saberkitty, he has to do whatever it takes to keep Fang safe.

eps.t: Indiana Flintstone / Dreamchip's Car Wash / Invasion of the Mommy Snatchers
eps.d: Cavey Jr. becomes Captain Caveman's sidekick after his birthday party and helps his dad fight Dr. Icemare, a weatherman who is stealing rock-frigerators to make Bedrock cold.
While at the Flintstone house, Barney answers the phone, winning a trip to the Captain Caveman Show. Fred becomes jealous because he was the one who told Barney to pick up the phone.

eps.t: Rubble Without a Cause / Dressed Up Dino / The Ditto Master
eps.d: During a visit to the museum, Fred and Barney sneak to a Indiana Stones exhibition and pretend to be Indiana and his faithful side-kick.
Dreamchip wants to test her new dog-washer on Dino. Fred agrees until Dreamchip calls Dino a mutt.

eps.t: Sugar and Spies / The Vet / I Was a Teenage Grown-Up
eps.d: Captain Caveman and son try to solve the mystery of all the mothers disappearing in Bedrock.
The gang forms a baseball team of their own.

eps.t: Freddy in the Big House / The Butcher Shop / Grime and Punishment
eps.d: After looking at the stars in a telescope at night, Barney imagines himself in a space sci-fi movie where Darth Ratrock has captured Princess Betty.

eps.t: The Rock Concert That Rocked Freddy
eps.d: Dino is forced to play dress up and tea party with the little girls.

eps.t: Bedrock P.I.'s / Freddy's Mechanical Dog / A Tale Too Silly
eps.d: Captain Caveman and Cavey Jr. face off against Ditto Master, a supervillain with a machine that enables him to duplicate himself and other things.
When Mr. and Mrs. Rubble think Fred and Barney did a great job babysitting Dusty, they make them take him to the carnival.

eps.t: Princess Wilma / The Dino Diet / To Baby or Not to Baby
eps.d: Freddy, Barney, Wilma, and Betty pretend to be agents after the mysterious Agent Dino 07.

eps.t: I Think That I Shall Never See Barney Rubble as a Tree / Dino Come Home
eps.d: After Dino misunderstands a conversation between Freddy and his father, he thinks they are taking him to the vet.

eps.t: Monster from the Tar Pits / What's Price Fleadom / Hero Today, Gone Tomorrow
eps.d: Dr. Bad tries to take the fun out of everything so life is dull.
Dreamchip's birthday is coming up, and her butler won't let her have a birthday party.

eps.t: The Twilight Stone / The Terror Within / Day of the Villians
eps.d: When Rocky frames Fred for playing baseball in the classroom, Fred has to write "I Will Not Play Baseball in Class" one hundred times.
Dino will do anything for some of the butcher's sausage.

eps.t: Betty's Big Break / Revenge of the Bullied / Curse of the Reverse
eps.d: Trash Man is making Bedrock all trashy. It's up to Captain Caveman and Cavey Jr. to stop him and clean up Bedrock.
Freddy promises everyone tickets to the Brick Stonespring concert. When Freddy is unable to get the tickets, he and Barney have to do whatever it takes to get everyone into the concert.

eps.t: Dino Goes Hollyrock / Chocolate Chip Catastrophe
eps.d: Fred and Barney become private eye detectives.

eps.t: The Little Visitor / Grandpa for Loan
eps.d: Dino is worried when Freddy gets a mechanical dog.

eps.t: Philo's Invention / Watchdog Blues / Leave It to Mother
eps.d: Yuckster steals eggs, flours, and Cowasauruses to make a pie large enough to throw at the entire city.
A doppelganger of Fred steals Dreamchip Gemstone's precious diamond, spoiling the Halloween party of the kids.

eps.t: Bedrock 'N' Roll / Greed It and Weep / Captain Cavepuppy
eps.d: Wilma has a cold and cannot go to the Bedrock Mall with Betty. While she is resting, she imagines herself as a princess.
Fred pretends to be sick so that he can avoid going to school.
Freddy's Aunt Hilda brings her kitty Sweetums on a visit to the Flintstone home.
Captain Caveman loses his memory while pursuing the Teddy Bear Snatcher.
Hollyrock star Shades Stone moves to Bedrock, impressing Fred and Betty, but not Wilma and Barney.
The snooty people at a prestigious dog training school snub Dino and Freddy.

eps.t: Attack of the Fifty Foot Teenage Lizard (Captain Caveman and Son)
eps.d: A teenage Godzilla-type monster named Billy is under pressure from his family to be destructive, but he bears no hatred towards cavepeople.
The boys find a little egg belonging to a big dinosaur.
After Barney mistakenly drinks one of Philo's secret potions, the mention of certain foods causes him to transform into a mean, towering humanoid and attack Rocky.

eps.t: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Betty
eps.d: Betty thinks she can do everything better with her ice cream business since other ice cream companies get in her way.
Fred tries to save money for a new toy car by letting Barney cut his hair.
While on a club scout trip in the woods, the gang tries to earn their merit badges, competing against Rocky and his gang.
As Edna and Freddy prepare for Ed's birthday dinner, mischievous Dino attempts to pilfer some food.

eps.t: The Cream-pier Strikes Back (Captain Caveman and Son)
eps.d: Yuckster is throwing cream pies which contain a formula that turns anyone hit by them into Yucksters.
After being sent to the principal's office again, Rocky has one last chance to be nice around the other students rather than be a mean bully.
While watching his favorite show, Dino is surprised by a visitor: a flea.

eps.t: Captain Caveman's Super Cold (Captain Caveman and Son)
eps.d: Captain Caveman has come down with a cold and does everything she can to try to get rid of it without having to visit a doctor.
When Freddy and Betty discover two discarded Halloween costumes, they prepare for a fun night of trick-or-treating.
After being scolded for not appreciating Freddy's care, Dino falls asleep and dreams that he and Freddy have switched places.

eps.t: The Big Bedrock Bully Bash (Captain Caveman and Son)
eps.d: Butch the Bully gets exposed to an experimental growth light and becomes a giant.
Philo gets his first D grade after failing to finish his science project.
Despite Freddy's warnings, Dino can't wait to open his birthday present.
With help from fellow inmates Piggy McGrabit, Trash Man, Teddy Bear Snatchter, and Yuckster, Mr. Bad escapes from prison.

eps.t: The Flintstone Kids Just Say No
